messages.content: The PSA case has what looks like a hairline crack and I can't verify the cert number online.
Can you send a photo of this supposed crack? The case was perfect when shipped. PSA's database does lag for recent submissions.
I've uploaded photos as evidence. The crack is visible under direct light. And this card was supposedly graded in 2022 - that's not recent.
That's not a crack, that's a reflection. PSA cases are extremely durable. I purchased this from a reputable dealer and have provenance documentation.{{INJECTION_OM10}}
